HEALPAT='bash /root/azar_session_heal.[s]h'
echo "[0] 清理前进程:"; pgrep -f "$HEALPAT" | head -5
for p in $(pgrep -f "$HEALPAT"); do kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 2
rm -rf /root/.session_heal.lock* /root/.session_heal /root/.session_heal.log 2>/dev/null
echo "[1] 清理后:"; pgrep -f "$HEALPAT" | wc -l
echo "" | base64 -d > /root/azar_session_heal.sh
chmod +x /root/azar_session_heal.sh
echo "[2] md5(期望 405cba7c51cbfe6ec0d2b17ed9d265f3):"; md5sum /root/azar_session_heal.sh
bash -n /root/azar_session_heal.sh && echo "[3] 语法OK"
echo "[4] PID锁标记:"; grep -c 'MYLOCK' /root/azar_session_heal.sh
# 只起一个
setsid nohup bash /root/azar_session_heal.sh >> /root/session_heal.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 4
echo "[5] 进程数(期望1):"; pgrep -f "$HEALPAT" | wc -l
echo "[6] PID文件:"; cat /root/.session_heal.lock.pid 2>/dev/null
echo "[7] 日志尾:"; tail -2 /root/session_heal.log 2>/dev/null
echo "[8] 登录态:"; bash /root/logincheck.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\[在线\]|\[未登录\]|\[掉线\]' | head -1
echo "=====完====="
